name: Nicolás Pascual de la Parte - § 92/2
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: including sexual and reproductive health and rights;
part_context: Emphasises the disproportionate and unique impact of armed conflicts on women and girls, especially in terms of conflict-related sexual violence; highlights the imperative need to ensure the provision and accessibility of the appropriate healthcare in armed conflicts, including sexual and reproductive health and rights; calls on the EU and Member States to ensure that armed conflicts are considered through a gender lens;
